solver: Basilisk C qcc, 2-D quadtree uniform Cartesian grid, centered Stokes + VOF + tension.h automatic curvature
basilisk_release_or_darcs_revision: not recorded in the installed build; executable and key-header hashes are recorded
interface: flat liquid layer below y=0, gas above y=0; periodic x; no-slip top and bottom

silver_literature_slope_sensitivity.normalization: dimensionless beta*=0.5*(beta/beta_ref), beta_ref=+0.546 mN/(m K); grad_T*=0.01; tau*=beta* grad_T*

agred.atmosphere: Ar/He + 5% H2; 2.6 ppm H2O; apparent oxygen partial pressure varies with temperature

silver_literature_slope_sensitivity.source: Morohoshi et al., J. Japan Inst. Metals 72 (2008), 708-713, doi:10.2320/jinstmet.72.708
silver_literature_slope_sensitivity.meaning: sign and flow-direction sensitivity only; not an Ag dimensional-velocity prediction

surface_shear: tau=d_sigma_dT*grad_T; imposed force density tau*|grad(f)| e_x
analytical_interface_velocity: U=tau*H/(mu_liquid+mu_gas) for equal layer heights H; here H=mu_liquid=mu_gas=1, so U=tau/2
official_basilisk_marangoni_case: https://basilisk.fr/src/test/marangoni.c; not present in the installed source mirror, so no code-to-code reproduction is claimed

surface_force_closure.normal_force: sigma*kappa*n using Basilisk automatic height-function curvature
surface_force_closure.tangential_force: projected surface gradient grad_s(sigma); both forces integrated over PLIC interface segments
